scope: Display-only imagery repair; no elevation, simulation or route changes

policy.detection: Large connected near-black or dark-purple areas only where the terrain support mask is uncertain; this is a conservative visual heuristic, not official NoData semantics.
policy.fallback: Geographically registered lower-resolution IGN imagery; OpenStreetMap cartography only if lower-resolution imagery is also unavailable.
policy.color: Local color matching uses surrounding imagery and affects filled pixels only.
policy.uncertainty: Unsupported elevation remains unknown. The imagery fill does not classify water, assign a height or alter simulation data.
